target_audience.primary_persona: Career-focused professionals in the Careersy Community seeking to enhance their LinkedIn presence with professional, AI-generated banners
secondary_personas: LinkedIn power users optimizing personal branding
Job seekers wanting to stand out with professional visuals
Freelancers and solo entrepreneurs building online presence
Career coaches helping clients improve LinkedIn profiles
pain_points: Lack of design skills to create professional LinkedIn banners
Expensive professional designers for simple branding tasks
Difficulty maintaining brand consistency across visual assets
No voice-first tools for hands-free creative workflows
goals: Create professional LinkedIn banners quickly without design skills
Maintain consistent personal branding across assets
Use AI to iterate and improve designs through natural conversation
Access multiple AI models for diverse creative outputs
Save and organize designs for easy retrieval and reuse
target_audience.usage_context: Desktop web browser (Chrome/Edge recommended for voice features), used during personal branding sessions, job searching periods, or profile refresh moments

product_vision.one_liner: AI-powered LinkedIn banner designer with voice-controlled workflows for professionals to create stunning banners in seconds
product_vision.problem_statement: Creating professional LinkedIn banners requires design skills most career professionals don't have, leading to generic or unprofessional profiles that fail to make the right first impression
product_vision.value_proposition: Multi-AI orchestration (Gemini, OpenRouter, Replicate) enables 4K image generation, intelligent editing, voice-powered workflows with 17 commands, and professional image processing - all without design expertise
success_metrics: Number of banners generated per user
User retention and return session rate
Time from signup to first banner export
Gallery shares and public designs created

existing_features: Multi-LLM AI integration (Gemini 3 Pro, OpenRouter, Replicate)
Voice-powered creation with 17 commands via OpenAI Realtime API
Background removal with transparent PNG output
Canvas editor with LinkedIn-specific safe zones
Multi-turn image editing with AI memory
Row Level Security for data isolation
Design saving and canvas state persistence
Performance metrics and AI usage tracking
Preview mode for cost control on image operations
known_gaps: Some type safety issues (any types in services)
Tool chain builder not fully implemented
technical_debt: Type safety improvements needed in API services
Context splitting still evolving (CanvasContext was recently split)
Test coverage gaps in some components
Documentation for some features still in progress

alternatives: Canva - General-purpose design tool with templates
Adobe Express - Professional design with AI features
differentiators: LinkedIn banner specialization with safe zone awareness
Multi-AI orchestration (Gemini + OpenRouter + Replicate) for best-in-class outputs
Multi-turn conversational image editing with AI memory
BYOK (Bring Your Own Keys) deployment model
competitive_context.market_position: Niche vertical AI tool focused specifically on LinkedIn banner creation for career-focused professionals, differentiating from general-purpose design tools through voice-first workflows and LinkedIn-specific optimizations

technical: Requires modern browser with WebSocket support for voice features
Chrome/Edge recommended for optimal voice agent performance
Multiple AI API keys required (Gemini, OpenRouter, Replicate, OpenAI)
Supabase backend dependency for auth and data persistence
CORS handling for Replicate proxy in development
resources: Active development with AI-assisted agent workflow
Careersy Community providing pilot testing and feedback
dependencies: Google Gemini API for primary image generation
OpenAI Realtime API for voice agent
Supabase for authentication, database, and storage
